title: How Free Apps Make Money: $63B in 3 Months From Ads
description:
How do free apps like Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp make money? Ads. In July to September 2026, Meta earned $63.1 billion from advertising, about 98% of its revenue, or roughly $685 million a day. With 3.64 billion daily users, its apps brought in about $17.72 per person in that one quarter. Meta showed 10% more ads than a year earlier and charged 14% more for each.

Sources: Meta Platforms Q3 2026 results (Oct 21, 2026) and Q2 2026 results (Jul 29, 2026). Revenue per person is Family of Apps revenue divided by average daily active people at the start and end of the quarter (Meta's definition), computed from those releases.

#instagram #meta #business #socialmedia #advertising

scenes.say: Instagram is free. Yet in just three months, its owner Meta made sixty-three billion dollars from ads.

visual.label: Meta ad revenue, July to Sept 2026

scenes.say: That's about six hundred and eighty-five million dollars, every single day.
Here's the trick. You're not the customer. Advertisers are. They pay to put ads in front of your attention, and the better Meta knows what you like, the more an ad is worth.
Compared with a year earlier, Meta showed ten percent more ads, and charged fourteen percent more for each one.
Spread across three point six billion daily users, each person brought in about seventeen dollars seventy in that one quarter.

visual.label: revenue per daily user, one quarter
visual.sub: Q3 2026 · 3.64B people use Meta's apps daily

scenes.say: So when an app is free, you're not paying with money. You're paying with your time.
Follow if this changed how you think about money.
